HARNESS : Disassembly and Assembly".
Revision: October 2013

text_elements.text: Note the following items, and disassembly in the reverse order of disassembly.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: There is the danger of electric shock caused by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Because there is a danger of electric shock and fire, never allow bus bar to contact a wrong terminal.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: -If bus bar contacts a wrong terminal, the circuit becomes energized and a short may occur.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: -Always keep the bus bar cover closed until immediately before the installation of bus bar.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: -Since the correct installation position for the bus bar connected to both front module stacks is commonly-confused with the wrong position , install the bus bar to the correct position with extreme caution.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Install the Li-ion battery controller immediately before installing the battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Perform the 'LI-ION BATTERY JUNCTION BOX DATA CLEAR' when battery junction box is replaced. Refer to EVC-148, "Work Procedure".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to reinstall the high voltage harness clips in their original positions. If a clip is damaged, replace it with a new clip before installing.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Check the following items after installing battery pack: Refer to EVB-269, "Inspection".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY HEATER : Disassembly and Assembly
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent the removed service plug from being connected by mistake during the procedure, always carry it in your pocket or put it in the tool box.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock hazards, ignition, and damage to parts, always remove Li-ion battery controller before disassembling battery pack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: WORK ENVIRONMENT FOR DISASSEMBLY OF LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: The work environment must be able to be isolated from the outside by shutters or other means to prevent the intrusion of rain, snow, sand, and other substances.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The environment must prevent the entry of sweat during work, and also prevent condensation from occurring as a result of high temperature and humidity.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: In  addition  to  being  indoors,  the  environment  must  not  permit  the  entry  during  disassembly  work  of metal powders, oil, or foreign substances resulting from causes such as servicing of other vehicles.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: If there is any risk of the above, use a plastic curtain or other means to block off the work area, or take other necessary steps.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The floor must not become wet as a result of causes such as vehicles entering when it is raining or snowing.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Space approximately the size of one vehicle must be secured as the disassembly space.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: A sign indicating that disassembly is in progress or other measures must be taken so that persons other than the workers do not enter the work space.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove battery pack upper case. Refer to EVB-204, "BATTERY PACK UPPER CASE : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock hazards, be sure to put on insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove mounting nuts and then remove Li-ion battery heaters.
